title: The Weekly Challenge - 399
task1_desc: You are given a string str and an integer k > 0. Write a script to choose any character of str and change it to another character. You may perform this operation up to k times. Return the length of the longest reachable substring of a single letter.
task2_desc: You are given a filesystem as string. Write a script to return the length of the longest absolute path to a file in the abstracted file system. If there is no file in the system, return 0.
